selection.numerical_resolution_note: Paired screening uses the original mesh, 10 s steps and hemicube resolution 20. Solid-mesh, time-step and angular-resolution discrepancies are reported independently; fine-mesh transfer of sensitivities requires a separate cross-check before claiming resolution-independent input bands.

assumptions.joint_initial_state_note: Combined-input cases start from a phase-zero affine combination of the qualified endpoint nodal fields. This is an initialization guess only; all reported joint results come from full nonlinear ANSYS runs with independently checked final periodicity. Chosen before observing joint-case results.
assumptions.purpose: Assumption-based input uncertainty screening of the reconstructed model; not experimental validation or a statistical explanation of the source-paper discrepancy.
assumptions.range_basis: The paper supplies nominal constants, not uncertainty intervals. All half-widths below are analyst-declared engineering assumptions, fixed before the scenario results.
assumptions.distribution_assumption: Independent uniform normalized inputs on [-1,1]; capacity_scale is one correlated multiplier on all material heat capacities. No measured probabilities are claimed.

external_epsilon.scope: exterior thermal emission and Earth-IR absorption together

capacity_scale.scope: all specific heat capacities; density and geometry fixed

assumptions.method: Paired full-ANSYS endpoint scenarios, local central-difference response propagation and midpoint-curvature checks. Numerical resolution effects are reported separately and are not disguised as physical input uncertainty.
exclusions: orbital beta, attitude and ephemeris uncertainty
model-form disagreement with the source solver
assumptions.joint_check_design: After paired screening, choose the high/low endpoint of each factor that raises battery average at the nominal battery-peak phase. Solve that combined corner and its opposite with full nonlinear ANSYS. These check the affine approximation; they are not reference-data fits.
assumptions.curvature_interpretation: Midpoint deviations are compared with the magnitude of input responses. Orbital periodicity defects and numerical-resolution changes limit interpretation of small curvature values.
assumptions.periodicity_tightening_basis: Tightened from 0.1 K after observing the capacity_scale=0.9 cycle defect of 0.0756 K. Smaller sensitivities and curvature checks require lower residual drift. This changes numerical qualification only; all physical ranges and nominal values remain fixed.

input_uncertainty.band_note: Conditional pointwise local affine propagation with independent assumed uniform ranges. These are scenario quantiles, not measured confidence intervals or full nonlinear joint ANSYS results. The same sampled inputs apply at every phase of each trajectory.
input_uncertainty.numerical_resolution_note: Paired screening uses the original mesh, 10 s steps and hemicube resolution 20. Solid-mesh, time-step and angular-resolution discrepancies are reported independently; fine-mesh transfer of sensitivities requires a separate cross-check before claiming resolution-independent input bands.
input_uncertainty.source_band_comparison_note: Coverage is a descriptive fraction of digitized source-curve samples under analyst-chosen bands, not a probabilistic model-validation test. Geometry, forcing interpretation and model-form discrepancies remain outside the input ranges.
